market_story: The 2023 ECRS-era scarcity price level the LP cannot form competitively is carried by the DOF-ledgered k_peak scalar on the gas peak bands — at k=33 the top tranches saturate at the offer cap ($4,999.99 clip), which is exactly the documented 2023 conduct: submitted evening asks clustered at the $5,000 SWCAP (ercot-161/162). The SWCAP clip is the market's own rule (offers cannot exceed the cap; firm-load shed is an EEA action, never an economic outcome), so scarce hours price AT the cap through dispatched supply instead of shedding. Gas peak tranches clear the Jun-Sep afternoon-evening ramps at the lifted band levels; coal, storage and renewables carry their measured curves unchanged (coal within 0.1 TWh of the pre-lift recipe in every leg); storage cycles into the same evening scarcity windows the adaptive-expectation floor prices.
